menu_options.detect: Press a button on the remote to detect it

detect_timeout.title: No remote detected
detect_timeout.description: No button press from a new Philips remote was seen in 60 seconds. Make sure the remote is within range of Home Assistant's Bluetooth and try again.

detect_confirm.title: Remote found
detect_confirm.description: Found remote {address} (you pressed **{button}**, battery {battery}%). Add it?

progress.press_button: Press any button on the remote now. Waiting up to 60 seconds…

error.invalid_address: That isn't a valid Bluetooth address.

abort.already_configured: This remote is already set up.
abort.not_supported: This device doesn't look like a supported Philips remote.

data_description.double_press: Fire a "<button>_double" event when a button is pressed twice within 0.5 seconds. Every press is then held for 0.5 seconds to see whether a second one follows, which delays single presses. When off, presses are reported instantly and double presses are not detected.
